scheme_name: Kanya Saksharta Protsahan Yojana (For Scheduled Caste Girls)
other_conditions: Must have passed Class 10 and be entering Class 11
Must be enrolled in a government or recognized school/institution and attend regularly
Parents or guardians should not be income taxpayers
benefits_summary: Eligible SC girl students entering Class 11 receive a ₹3,000 per year incentive paid into their bank accounts.
